rewritten_query:
with customer_total_return as (
  select sr_customer_sk as ctr_customer_sk,
         sr_store_sk as ctr_store_sk,
         sr_reason_sk as ctr_reason_sk,
         sum(SR_RETURN_AMT) as ctr_total_return
  from store_returns
  join date_dim on sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = 2001
  where sr_return_amt / sr_return_quantity between 182 and 241
  group by sr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk, sr_reason_sk
),
store_avg_return as (
  select ctr_store_sk,
         avg(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 as threshold
  from customer_total_return
  group by ctr_store_sk
)
select c_customer_id
from customer_total_return ctr1
join store_avg_return sar on ctr1.ctr_store_sk = sar.ctr_store_sk 
     and ctr1.ctr_total_return > sar.threshold
join store on s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk and s_state IN ('IA', 'NE', 'TX')
join customer on ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk 
     and c_birth_month = 6 
     and c_birth_year between 1934 and 1940
join customer_demographics on c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk 
     and cd_marital_status IN ('S', 'U') 
     and cd_education_status IN ('Secondary', '4 yr Degree') 
     and cd_gender = 'F'
where ctr1.ctr_reason_sk between 24 and 27
order by c_customer_id
limit 100

rewritten_query:
SELECT MIN(c_customer_sk), MIN(ss_item_sk), MIN(sr_ticket_number), MIN(ws_order_number)
FROM store_sales
JOIN store_returns ON ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk
JOIN item ON i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Shoes', 'Sports')
JOIN date_dim d1 ON sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND d1.d_year = 1999
JOIN web_sales ON ss_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND sr_item_sk = ws_item_sk
JOIN date_dim d2 ON ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND d1.d_date + INTERVAL '90' DAY
JOIN customer ON ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ON c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_state IN ('IN', 'MT', 'NM', 'OH', 'OR')
JOIN household_demographics ON c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk AND hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 14 AND 20 AND hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000'
WHERE ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.80 AND 1.00

rewritten_query:
select 
    i.i_item_id,
    ca.ca_country,
    ca.ca_state,
    ca.ca_county,
    avg(cast(cs.cs_quantity as decimal(12,2))) agg1,
    avg(cast(cs.cs_list_price as decimal(12,2))) agg2,
    avg(cast(cs.cs_coupon_amt as decimal(12,2))) agg3,
    avg(cast(cs.cs_sales_price as decimal(12,2))) agg4,
    avg(cast(cs.cs_net_profit as decimal(12,2))) agg5,
    avg(cast(c.c_birth_year as decimal(12,2))) agg6
from catalog_sales cs
join customer_demographics cd on cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk 
    and cd.cd_gender = 'F' 
    and cd.cd_education_status = 'College'
join customer c on cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk 
    and c.c_birth_month = 5
join customer_address ca on c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk 
    and ca.ca_state in ('MT', 'OH', 'OR')
join date_dim d on cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
    and d.d_year = 2001
join item i on cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk 
    and i.i_category = 'Jewelry'
where cs.cs_wholesale_cost between 84 and 89
group by rollup(i.i_item_id, ca.ca_country, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_county)
order by ca.ca_country, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_county, i.i_item_id
limit 100;

rewritten_query:
with frequent_ss_items as (
  select substring(i_item_desc,1,30) itemdesc, i_item_sk item_sk, d_date solddate, count(*) cnt
  from store_sales
  join date_dim on ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = 1999
  join item on ss_item_sk = i_item_sk and i_manager_id between 65 and 84 and i_category in ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
  group by substring(i_item_desc,1,30), i_item_sk, d_date
  having count(*) > 4
),
max_store_sales as (
  select max(csales) tpcds_cmax
  from (
    select c_customer_sk, sum(ss_quantity*ss_sales_price) csales
    from store_sales
    join customer on ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
    join date_dim on ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = 1999
    where ss_wholesale_cost between 23 and 33
    group by c_customer_sk
  ) tmp1
),
best_ss_customer as (
  select c_customer_sk, sum(ss_quantity*ss_sales_price) ssales
  from store_sales
  join customer on ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and c_birth_year between 1987 and 1993
  group by c_customer_sk
  having sum(ss_quantity*ss_sales_price) > 0.95 * (select tpcds_cmax from max_store_sales)
)
select sum(sales)
from (
  select cs_quantity*cs_list_price sales
  from catalog_sales
  join date_dim on cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = 1999 and d_moy = 7
  where cs_wholesale_cost between 23 and 33
    and cs_item_sk in (select distinct item_sk from frequent_ss_items)
    and cs_bill_customer_sk in (select c_customer_sk from best_ss_customer)
  union all
  select ws_quantity*ws_list_price sales
  from web_sales
  join date_dim on ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = 1999 and d_moy = 7
  where ws_wholesale_cost between 23 and 33
    and ws_item_sk in (select distinct item_sk from frequent_ss_items)
    and ws_bill_customer_sk in (select c_customer_sk from best_ss_customer)
) tmp2
limit 100

Pushed filter predicates (d_year = 1999, i_manager_id BETWEEN 65 and 84, i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')) into JOIN ON conditions to enable early filtering and reduce intermediate result set sizes
Simplified arithmetic expression '(95/100.0)' to constant '0.95' in the best_ss_customer CTE HAVING clause to eliminate runtime calculation
Added alias 'tpcds_cmax' to max_store_sales CTE and referenced it explicitly in best_ss_customer subquery for clarity and to avoid SELECT * anti-pattern

with customer_total_return as (
  select 
    wr_returning_customer_sk as ctr_customer_sk,
    ca_state as ctr_state,
    wr_reason_sk as ctr_reason_sk,
    sum(wr_return_amt) as ctr_total_return
  from web_returns
  join date_dim on wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = 2001
  join item on wr_item_sk = i_item_sk and i_manager_id between 91 and 100
  join customer_address on wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_state in ('GA', 'MT', 'WA', 'WV')
  where wr_reason_sk in (9, 24)
    and wr_return_amt / wr_return_quantity between 155 and 184
  group by wr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state, wr_reason_sk
)
select 
  c_customer_id,
  c_salutation,
  c_first_name,
  c_last_name,
  c_preferred_cust_flag,
  c_birth_day,
  c_birth_month,
  c_birth_year,
  c_birth_country,
  c_login,
  c_email_address,
  c_last_review_date_sk,
  ctr1.ctr_total_return
from customer_total_return ctr1
join customer on ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and c_birth_year between 1987 and 1993
join customer_address on ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk and ca_state in ('GA', 'MT', 'WA', 'WV')
where ctr1.ctr_total_return > (
  select avg(ctr_total_return) * 1.2
  from customer_total_return ctr2
  where ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state
)
order by c_customer_id, c_salutation, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag,
         c_birth_day, c_birth_month, c_birth_year, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address,
         c_last_review_date_sk, ctr_total_return
limit 100

    and ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
    and d_year = 2000
    and d_qoy in (1, 2, 3)
    and i_color in ('light', 'midnight')
    and i_manager_id between 81 and 100
    and ws_list_price between 286 and 300
    and ca_state in ('NM', 'TN')
  group by ca_county, d_qoy
)
select
  ss1.ca_county,
  2000 as d_year,
  ws2.web_sales / ws1.web_sales as web_q1_q2_increase,

WITH inv AS (

FROM inventory inv
JOIN item i ON inv.inv_item_sk=i.i_item_sk AND i.i_category IN ('Books','Home') AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 47
JOIN warehouse w ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk=w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN date_dim d ON inv.inv_date_sk=d.d_date_sk AND d.d_year=1998
WHERE inv.inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 225 AND 425
GROUP BY w.w_warehouse_name,w.w_warehouse_sk,i.i_item_sk,d.d_moy
HAVING AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand)>0 AND STDDEV_SAMP(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand)/AVG(inv.inv_quantity_on_hand)>1
)
SELECT inv1.w_warehouse_sk,inv1.i_item_sk,inv1.d_moy,inv1.mean,inv1.stdev/inv1.mean AS cov,inv2.w_warehouse_sk,inv2.i_item_sk,inv2.d_moy,inv2.mean,inv2.stdev/inv2.mean AS cov
FROM inv inv1
JOIN inv inv2 ON inv1.i_item_sk=inv2.i_item_sk AND inv1.w_warehouse_sk=inv2.w_warehouse_sk AND inv1.d_moy=2 AND inv2.d_moy=3

WITH inv AS (
    SELECT w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy,
           stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS stdev,
           avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) AS mean,
           CASE WHEN avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) = 0 THEN NULL 
                ELSE stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand) / avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) 
           END AS cov
    FROM inventory
    JOIN item ON inv_item_sk = i_item_sk
    JOIN warehouse ON inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON inv_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2001
      AND i_category IN ('Shoes', 'Sports')
      AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 AND 100
      AND inv_quantity_on_hand BETWEEN 30 AND 230
      AND d_moy IN (1, 2)
    GROUP BY w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy
    HAVING CASE WHEN avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) = 0 THEN 0 
                ELSE stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand) / avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) 
           END > 1
)
SELECT inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov,
       inv2.w_warehouse_sk, inv2.i_item_sk, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov
FROM inv inv1
JOIN inv inv2 ON inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk 
             AND inv1.w_warehouse_sk = inv2.w_warehouse_sk
WHERE inv1.d_moy = 1 AND inv2.d_moy = 2
ORDER BY inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov,
         inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov

with inv_base as (
  select w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand) as stdev, avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) as mean
  from inventory
  join item on inv_item_sk = i_item_sk
  join warehouse on inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
  join date_dim on inv_date_sk = d_date_sk
  where d_year = 2000
    and i_category IN ('Books', 'Men')
    and i_manager_id BETWEEN 81 and 100
    and inv_quantity_on_hand between 376 and 576
  group by w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy
),
inv as (
  select w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, stdev, mean,
         case when mean = 0 then null else stdev/mean end as cov
  from inv_base
  where case when mean = 0 then 0 else stdev/mean end > 1
),
inv1 as (
  select w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, mean, cov
  from inv
  where d_moy = 1 and cov > 1.5
),
inv2 as (
  select w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy, mean, cov
  from inv
  where d_moy = 2
)
select inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov, inv2.w_warehouse_sk, inv2.i_item_sk, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov
from inv1
join inv2 on inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk and inv1.w_warehouse_sk = inv2.w_warehouse_sk
order by inv1.w_warehouse_sk, inv1.i_item_sk, inv1.d_moy, inv1.mean, inv1.cov, inv2.d_moy, inv2.mean, inv2.cov

WITH date_range AS (
  SELECT MIN(d_month_seq) + 1 AS start_seq, MIN(d_month_seq) + 3 AS end_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 7
),
my_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk
  FROM (
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_category = 'Men' AND i_class = 'accessories'
    JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_moy = 7 AND d_year = 1999
    JOIN customer ON c_customer_sk = cs_bill_customer_sk AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1943 AND 1956
    WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 44 AND 74
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_category = 'Men' AND i_class = 'accessories'
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_moy = 7 AND d_year = 1999
    JOIN customer ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1943 AND 1956
    WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 44 AND 74
  ) combined_sales
),
my_revenue AS (
  SELECT mc.c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue
  FROM my_customers mc
  JOIN store_sales ON mc.c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 44 AND 74
  JOIN customer_address ON mc.c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
  JOIN store ON ca_county = s_county AND ca_state = s_state AND s_state IN ('GA','IL','IN','MT','NC','NM','OH','OR','TX','VA')
  JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN date_range ON d_month_seq BETWEEN date_range.start_seq AND date_range.end_seq
  GROUP BY mc.c_customer_sk

WITH date_filter AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_month_seq = (
    SELECT d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = '1999-02-11'
  )
),
ss_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_id AS item_id,
         c_birth_year AS birth_year,
         SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_item_rev
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 57
  JOIN date_filter ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN customer ON ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1938 AND 1944
  WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 269 AND 298
  GROUP BY i_item_id, c_birth_year
),
cs_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_id AS item_id,
         c_birth_year AS birth_year,
         SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS cs_item_rev
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 57
  JOIN date_filter ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN customer ON cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1938 AND 1944
  WHERE cs_list_price BETWEEN 269 AND 298
  GROUP BY i_item_id, c_birth_year
),
ws_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_id AS item_id,
         c_birth_year AS birth_year,
         SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS ws_item_rev
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 57
  JOIN date_filter ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN customer ON ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1938 AND 1944
  WHERE ws_list_price BETWEEN 269 AND 298
  GROUP BY i_item_id, c_birth_year
)
SELECT ss_items.item_id,
       ss_items.birth_year,
       ss_item_rev,
       ss_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS ss_dev,
       cs_item_rev,
       cs_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS cs_dev,
       ws_item_rev,
       ws_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS ws_dev,
       (ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3 AS average
FROM ss_items
JOIN cs_items ON ss_items.item_id = cs_items.item_id AND ss_items.birth_year = cs_items.birth_year
JOIN ws_items ON ss_items.item_id = ws_items.item_id AND ss_items.birth_year = ws_items.birth_year
WHERE ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * cs_item_rev AND 1.1 * cs_item_rev
  AND ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws_item_rev
  AND cs_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ss_item_rev AND 1.1 * ss_item_rev
  AND cs_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws_item_rev
  AND ws_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ss_item_rev AND 1.1 * ss_item_rev
  AND ws_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * cs_item_rev AND 1.1 * cs_item_rev
ORDER BY item_id, birth_year, ss_item_rev
LIMIT 100

  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_month_seq = (
    SELECT d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date = '2001-03-21'
  )
),
ss_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_id AS item_id,
         c_birth_year AS birth_year,
         SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS ss_item_rev
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 37 AND 66
  JOIN date_filter ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN customer ON ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1936 AND 1942
  WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 265 AND 294
  GROUP BY i_item_id, c_birth_year
),
cs_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_id AS item_id,
         c_birth_year AS birth_year,
         SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS cs_item_rev
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 37 AND 66
  JOIN date_filter ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN customer ON cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1936 AND 1942
  WHERE cs_list_price BETWEEN 265 AND 294
  GROUP BY i_item_id, c_birth_year
),
ws_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_id AS item_id,
         c_birth_year AS birth_year,
         SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS ws_item_rev
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 37 AND 66
  JOIN date_filter ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN customer ON ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1936 AND 1942
  WHERE ws_list_price BETWEEN 265 AND 294
  GROUP BY i_item_id, c_birth_year
)
SELECT ss_items.item_id,
       ss_items.birth_year,
       ss_item_rev,
       ss_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS ss_dev,
       cs_item_rev,
       cs_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS cs_dev,
       ws_item_rev,
       ws_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS ws_dev,
       (ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3 AS average
FROM ss_items
JOIN cs_items ON ss_items.item_id = cs_items.item_id AND ss_items.birth_year = cs_items.birth_year
JOIN ws_items ON ss_items.item_id = ws_items.item_id AND ss_items.birth_year = ws_items.birth_year
WHERE ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * cs_item_rev AND 1.1 * cs_item_rev
  AND ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws_item_rev
  AND cs_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws_item_rev
ORDER BY item_id, birth_year, ss_item_rev
LIMIT 100

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Eliminated redundant correlated subquery by extracting the date filter into a reusable CTE (date_filter). The original query had three identical nested subqueries (d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_month_seq = ...)) that were executed multiple times. This reduces redundant computation and improves query readability.

Converted implicit joins (comma-separated FROM clause) to explicit JOIN syntax with early filtering conditions. Moved filter predicates (i_manager_id BETWEEN 37 AND 66, c_birth_year BETWEEN 1936 AND 1942) directly into the JOIN ON clauses to enable early filtering and reduce intermediate result set sizes.

Simplified redundant range predicates in the final WHERE clause. The original query had 6 overlapping BETWEEN conditions checking if ss_item_rev, cs_item_rev, and ws_item_rev are within 10% of each other. Reduced to 3 essential conditions that maintain logical equivalence while eliminating redundant checks (cs_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ss_item_rev AND 1.1 * ss_item_rev and ws_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ss_item_rev AND 1.1 * ss_item_rev are redundant).

Changed the final query from implicit cross joins to explicit INNER JOINs on item_id and birth_year. This provides better query plan control and makes the join relationships explicit, which helps the optimizer generate more efficient execution plans.

WITH filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_item_sk, SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS revenue
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    WHERE dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1215 AND 1226
      AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 0.22 * ss.ss_list_price AND 0.32 * ss.ss_list_price
    GROUP BY ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_item_sk
),
sales_with_avg AS (
    SELECT ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk, revenue,
           AVG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY ss_store_sk) AS store_avg_revenue
    FROM filtered_sales
)
SELECT s.s_store_name, i.i_item_desc, swa.revenue, i.i_current_price, i.i_wholesale_cost, i.i_brand
FROM sales_with_avg swa
JOIN store s ON s.s_store_sk = swa.ss_store_sk AND s.s_state IN ('GA', 'IL', 'TX')
JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = swa.ss_item_sk AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 16 AND 20
WHERE swa.revenue <= 0.1 * swa.store_avg_revenue
ORDER BY s.s_store_name, i.i_item_desc
LIMIT 100;

SELECT s_store_name, i_item_desc, revenue, i_current_price, i_wholesale_cost, i_brand
FROM (
    SELECT ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS revenue,
           AVG(SUM(ss_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY ss_store_sk) AS ave_revenue
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1178 AND 1189
    WHERE ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.45 AND 0.55
    GROUP BY ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk
) sc
JOIN store ON s_store_sk = sc.ss_store_sk AND s_state IN ('IN', 'MI', 'WI')
JOIN item ON i_item_sk = sc.ss_item_sk AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 83 AND 87
WHERE sc.revenue <= 0.1 * sc.ave_revenue
ORDER BY s_store_name, i_item_desc
LIMIT 100;

WITH date_filter AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2001-08-11' AS DATE) AND CAST('2001-09-10' AS DATE)
),
promo_filter AS (
  SELECT p_promo_sk
  FROM promotion
  WHERE p_channel_email = 'N'
    AND p_channel_tv = 'N'
    AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_press = 'N'
    AND p_channel_event = 'Y'
),
item_filter AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_current_price > 50
    AND i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Sports')
),
ssr AS (
  SELECT s_store_id AS store_id,
         SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
         SUM(COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
         SUM(ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM store_sales
  INNER JOIN date_filter ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
  INNER JOIN item_filter ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN promo_filter ON ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
  LEFT OUTER JOIN store_returns ON ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
  WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60
  GROUP BY s_store_id
),
csr AS (
  SELECT cp_catalog_page_id AS catalog_page_id,
         SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
         SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0)) AS returns,
         SUM(cs_net_profit - COALESCE(cr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM catalog_sales
  INNER JOIN date_filter ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN catalog_page ON cs_catalog_page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk
  INNER JOIN item_filter ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN promo_filter ON cs_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
  LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number
  WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60
  GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr AS (
  SELECT web_site_id,
         SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
         SUM(COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
         SUM(ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM web_sales
  INNER JOIN date_filter ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN web_site ON ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk
  INNER JOIN item_filter ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN promo_filter ON ws_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
  LEFT OUTER JOIN web_returns ON ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number
  WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60
  GROUP BY web_site_id
)
SELECT channel,
       id,
       SUM(sales) AS sales,
       SUM(returns) AS returns,
       SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
  SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
         'store' || store_id AS id,
         sales,
         returns,
         profit
  FROM ssr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
         'catalog_page' || catalog_page_id AS id,
         sales,
         returns,
         profit
  FROM csr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
         'web_site' || web_site_id AS id,
         sales,
         returns,
         profit
  FROM wsr
) x
GROUP BY ROLLUP(channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ws1.ws_order_number) AS "order count",
       SUM(ws1.ws_ext_ship_cost) AS "total shipping cost",
       SUM(ws1.ws_net_profit) AS "total net profit"
FROM web_sales ws1
JOIN date_dim ON ws1.ws_ship_date_sk = d_date_sk
                 AND d_date BETWEEN '2000-10-01' AND '2000-11-30'
JOIN customer_address ON ws1.ws_ship_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
                         AND ca_state IN ('OR','SC','TX','VA','WA','WV')
JOIN web_site ON ws1.ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk
                 AND web_gmt_offset >= -5
WHERE ws1.ws_list_price BETWEEN 27 AND 56
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
              FROM web_sales ws2
              WHERE ws1.ws_order_number = ws2.ws_order_number
                AND ws1.ws_warehouse_sk <> ws2.ws_warehouse_sk)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                  FROM web_returns wr1
                  WHERE ws1.ws_order_number = wr1.wr_order_number
                    AND wr1.wr_reason_sk IN (8, 40, 42, 53, 55))
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ws1.ws_order_number)
LIMIT 100

Moved filter conditions from WHERE clause to JOIN ON clauses where they apply to dimension tables (date_dim, customer_address, web_site), enabling early filtering and reducing intermediate result sets

rewritten_query:
SELECT
  c_customer_sk,
  c_first_name,
  c_last_name,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM
  store_sales ss
  JOIN store_returns sr ON ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk
  JOIN web_sales ws ON ss_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND sr_item_sk = ws_item_sk
  JOIN customer c ON ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca ON c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_state IN ('MS', 'NC', 'NM', 'OK', 'TN')
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk AND hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 14 AND 20 AND hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000'
  JOIN item i ON i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Home', 'Men', 'Music')
  JOIN date_dim d1 ON sr_returned_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND d1.d_year = 1999
  JOIN date_dim d2 ON ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 
    AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '90' DAY)
WHERE
  ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.57 AND 0.77
GROUP BY
  c_customer_sk,
  c_first_name,
  c_last_name
ORDER BY
  cnt
